latest_release.name: v1.4.1
latest_release.body:
## Downloads
- **`gamenative-v1.4.1.apk`** — Standard build. Recommended for most users.
- **`gamenative-v1.4.1-legacy-xr.apk`** — XR build for Quest headsets.


## What's Changed

### Added after prerelease
* Added OpenGL 4.0 support on Mali/PowerVR in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2481
* EA games follow the container language in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2485
* fix: gamescope issues in 1.4.1 (fps limit, lsfg, cursor, and GL titles on the shim) by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2484
* Proton 11.0-2 13 + FEX 2611-gn-8 added, fixes Castlevania: Belmont's Curse using known config
* HTML5: collected runtime fixes (fs shim readdir, Electron preload/saves/entry/scroll, Construct bundles) by @jeremybernstein in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2466
* Rockstar: launch without internet by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2491
* Fixed games showing in library where root folder was `.` (Skeleton Hell) in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2496
* Fix Steam launches from frontends when not logged in in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2495
* Support for Adreno 85x in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2503
* HTML5: Wendy Quest no longer hangs on the load screen by @jeremybernstein in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2492
* HTML5: tilemap seams on Mali, more Get AI help diagnostics by @jeremybernstein in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2494

### From prerelease
* Added themes + configurable sounds including ones adapted from Decky in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2402
* Updated wrapper-gamenative to work correctly on almost all Mali, PowerVR and Exynos devices in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2262
* Added Optimize - make games run at smoother, higher FPS with less heat in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2363
* Fixed GTA IV, Hogwarts Legacy, Slay the Spire and Transistor (requires latest proton)
* Ubisoft Connect support for Steam games (requires Steam client in headless mode - cloud save uploads not tested and turned off by default) in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2428
* Added shared shader and FEX caching (less stutters, faster boot) in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2356
* gamescope: fixed tearing, use less memory and CPU, made rendering engine code public by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2393
* Added HTML5 native WebView runtime for Chromium-based games (makes them run way better!) by @jeremybernstein in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1570
* Local cloud save backups with restore in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2355
* Made app completely navigable by controller in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2460
* Fixed Gamescope controller issues in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2394 and https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2397
* run a known step of a game's Steam install script (fixes PlayStation library missing) by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2384
* Fixes for XCOM: Enemy Unknown (appmanifest and DLC) by @danielruttley in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2464 and https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2463
* Fixed Java games regression in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2422
* Fix "Unknown Fail" for cloud saves in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2400
* Fix storage manager size counting in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2367
* Keep the container executable on cold offline intent launches in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2365
* fix prefix installs the Common-Controls 6.0 assembly by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/2368
* Fix 32-bit CPU setting in https://github.com/utkarshda

# GameNative **Play the PC games you already own — from Steam, Epic and GOG — on your Android device, with cloud saves.** [![GitHub Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/utkarshdalal/GameNative?style=flat-square&logo=github&label=latest)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/releases/latest) [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/utkarshdalal/GameNative?style=flat-square&logo=github&color=ffd700)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/stargazers) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Fapi%2Fv9%2Finvites%2F2hKv4VfZfE%3Fwith_counts%3Dtrue&query=%24.approximate_member_count&style=flat-square&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=discord&color=5865F2&suffix=%20members)](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL%203.0-blue?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/blob/master/LICENSE) [![Membership](https://img.shields.io/badge/ko--fi-membership-FF5E5B?style=flat-square&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative) [**Download**](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/releases/download/v1.4.1/gamenative-v1.4.1.apk) · [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) · [**Become a member**](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative)
--- GameNative lets you run the PC games in your Steam, Epic and GOG libraries directly on Android — no streaming required. Your saves sync to the cloud, so you can stop on your PC and keep going on your phone. It's still early. Not every game runs yet, and some need tweaking to play well, but the community is constantly finding and sharing configs that work — and these get applied automatically. You can see if anyone has tried running your game successfully at https://gamenative.app/compatibility. ## What you get - Play games you actually own on Steam, Epic, GOG and Amazon - Cloud saves that carry over between your PC and your phone - Automatically applied known configs, so many games just work out of the box with no tweaking required - Controller and touch support, with a custom control editor and on-screen HUD - Steam DLC, workshop and branch support - Active support over Discord if you need help getting a game running - Optimize: games tuned to your device (members) - AI help that finds and fixes what's stopping a game from running (members) ## Demo [TechDweeb](https://www.youtube.com/@TechDweeb) walks through setting up GameNative on an Android handheld in a couple of minutes:
## How to use 1. Download the latest release [here](https://downloads.gamenative.app/releases/1.4.1/gamenative-v1.4.1.apk) 2. Install the APK on your Android device 3. Log in to your Steam account 4. Install your game 5. Hit play and enjoy ## Support The fastest way to get help is the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE) — we're 35k+ strong and someone's usually around. Please **don't** open issues on GitHub; they're closed automatically. Bring it to Discord instead. [**Become a member**](https://ko-fi.com/gamenative) to get Optimize, AI help and early access builds. Questions about paid features, or tuning games yourself? See the [FAQ](FAQ.md). ## Contributing Want to help out? Message us to get into the **#development** channel on [Discord](https://discord.gg/2hKv4VfZfE), or open a thread there. Things we're currently looking for help with live on our [Trello board](https://trello.com/b/vGRkFoAM/open-source-board). ### Fix a game that doesn't work Every night we publish the list of games that don't run in GameNative, built from real usage data, at [GameNative/gamenative-compat](https://github.com/GameNative/gamenative-compat). Each broken game has [an open issue](https://github.com/GameNative/gamenative-compat/issues?q=is%3Aopen+label%3Adoes-not-work) with the numbers behind it: how many players hit it, what they report, whether the game window ever renders. If you want to take one on: 1. Pick a game from the list and open its issue. Check the comments to see whether someone is already on it, then leave a comment saying you are taking it. 2. Work out why it fails. Most fixes land in this repo, in [proton-wine](https://github.com/GameNative/proton-wine), in [FEX](https://github.com/GameNative/FEX), in the GPU driver wrappers or in the per-game config. 3. Open a pull request in the right repo, then comment on the game's issue with a link to it. Once the fix ships and players start getting the game to run, the issue closes itself. Own a broken game and want to donate a key so someone can fix it? Email [support@gamenative.app](mailto:support@gamenative.app). ### Building Most of the time you don't need this — if you just want to play, grab the release above. This is for contributors. 1. After cloning, fetch the submodules (the vendored leveldb and snappy-java are built from them): ```sh git submodule update --init --recursive ``` 2. Build it like any normal Android Studio project. Ask on Discord if you get stuck. 3. **SteamGridDB API key (optional):** to pull game artwork for custom games, add your key to `local.properties`: ```properties STEAMGRIDDB_API_KEY=your_api_key_here ``` You can get one from your [SteamGridDB preferences](https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences). Without it everything still works — it just won't fetch images. ## Analytics & privacy GameNative uses [PostHog](https://posthog.com) for anonymous analytics. No personal information is ever collected — no names, emails, IPs or device identifiers. **Always collected**, to improve game compatibility: - Game launch, close and exit events (game name, store, session length, average FPS, container config) - Game install, cancel and uninstall events This is how we figure out which games work, how well they run, and which configs to apply automatically for the next person. It can't identify you. **Optional**, and switchable under *Settings → Info → Usage Analytics*: - Feature usage (on-screen keyboard, controller, HUD, control editor) - Login success/failure events - Recommendation interactions - App lifecycle events (foreground/background) - Cloud sync events The full [Privacy Policy](PrivacyPolicy/README.md) has the details. ## Sponsors GameNative is sponsored by [CodeRabbit](https://coderabbit.link/gnative). [![Star History Chart](https://star-history.dera.page/svg?repos=utkarshdalal/GameNative&type=Date&theme=dark)](https://star-history.dera.page/#utkarshdalal/GameNative&Date) ## License [GPL 3.0](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/blob/master/LICENSE). See [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES) for attributions, copyleft source offers, and notices about third-party and proprietary components bundled with the app. --- **Disclaimer:** This software is meant for playing games that you legally own. Don't use it for piracy or anything else illegal. The maintainer takes no responsibility for misuse.
